quest.title: Involuntary Sacrifice
quest.description: You hear from Ganyu and Lan that the Treasure Hoarders of Mondstadt and Liyue have banded together and plan to get involved in some ruins associated with the Abyss Order. Fearing the chaos that the Treasure Hoarders might cause through their involvement, you take up the commission and investigate...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x650, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Go near the Adventurers' Guild Bulletin Board

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Yes, yes. They have the audacity to go after anything.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: The Seven, dragons, gods... no ancient artifact that relates can escape their greedy ambitions.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Still, this time is different... Who do they think they are, going after the Abyss Order's treasures...?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Oh, Traveler, it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Ganyu, what are you doing here with Lan? Do you have a commission you need to post?

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: #Hello, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: We were just discussing the Treasure Hoarders.

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Yes, we were just saying how even the audacious Treasure Hoarders should know better than to mess with the Abyss — it's just too evil.

dialogues.speaker: Ganyu
dialogues.text: But we recently received intel from the Ministry of Civil Affairs that two big-time Treasure Hoarders in Liyue and Mondstadt are planning some big joint operation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Two big-time Treasure Hoarders"?

dialogues.speaker: Lan
dialogues.text: Yes, they're known as "Big Sis of the South" and "Raptor of the North."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ahh! Raptor! Paimon remembers he tried to run away from Amber in Mondstadt... But who is "Big Sis of the South"?

choices.text: Does "Big Sis" mean she bosses people around?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: You are correct. She is the head of the Treasure Hoarders in Liyue. As I understand it, the Treasure Hoarders all call her "Boss."

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Some say that the God of Thieves even bestowed a gift upon her for her exploits, making her "Big Sis of the Gods." ...But that's probably just a wild rumor.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Anyway, the Treasure Hoarders discovered some previously unexplored ruins that the Abyss Order has been secretly guarding in the shadows.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Despite how dangerous that makes it, all the Treasure Hoarders can think about is what kinds of treasure could be inside...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: They have already devised a plan: they will send out a decoy to divert the Abyss Order's forces away from the ruins, then send an expert thief inside to steal the treasure.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: To this end, Big Sis and Raptor have reportedly recruited a certain "Grand Thief" from Fontaine...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Grand Thief"? That's quite an impressive-sounding title.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Indeed. He is an extraordinary individual.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: The Grand Thief is highly respected in the Treasure Hoarders, in the same way that we adventurers look up to great adventurers.

choices.text: Just like the famous adventurer, Alice?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Ah, so you're familiar with the author of the Teyvat Travel Guide, then? Correct, the Grand Thief is someone as renowned as her.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: So, despite being relative big-timers in Liyue and Mondstadt, Big Sis and Raptor had to put in a lot of work to convince a thief of his status to come and personally oversee this operation.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: With the major changes in Liyue recently, the Ministry of Civil Affairs and the Millelith already have their hands full. They don't have any time to investigate rumors about Treasure Hoarder activity.

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: But anything related to the Abyss makes me feel like there is some unknown danger lurking beneath the surface...

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: So, I decided to come to the Adventurers' Guild to post a commission.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mm-hmmm! Leave this commission to us!

response.speaker: Ganyu
response.text: Oh, thank you so much.

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Good to see this in the hands of a reliable Guild member. Well then, good luck. The Guild will take care of the details of this commission.

choices.text: I, too, understand the dangers of the Abyss.
Just like the great adventurer, Stanley?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: Ah, you met the living legend himself while you were in Mondstadt? Correct, the Grand Thief is someone just as renowned as him.

choices.text: Is she the "Boss" the Treasure Hoarders refer to?

response.speaker: Lan
response.text: You already know something then. I guess you must have crossed paths with the Treasure Hoarders many times before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—This looks like a person!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be the Grand Thief?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why is he in that position? Is he praying to something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—Why is this Statue of The Seven... hanging upside-down...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And the statue's hands... Paimon remembers they are normally holding an orb, right?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But, this statue is holding... What is that?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... Paimon has a really bad feeling about this...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And the Grand Thief hasn't moved an inch. D—Do you think he's...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um... hello...? Are you okay mister?

response.speaker: Observe the "Grand Thief"
response.text: (There's no reaction, nor any sign of breathing.)

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...H—He's dead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon doesn't feel so good, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's get out of here, and fast! We should report back to Ganyu and Lan...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaah! Now what!?

choices.text: Some strange thing that I've never seen...

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: This power... It seems familiar...

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: Hmph...!

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: I see... So, it's you... you are the one!

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: In that case, I shall stay here no longer...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whew... What a tough battle. Are you okay, {NICKNAME}?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Such a strong enemy. Who knew the Abyss Order had monsters this powerful among them?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It seemed to... know me.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? What is it? What are you thinking about?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Nothing, let's just get out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right, yeah... We're near the exit now. Let's get outta this scary place before something even more dangerous shows up!

talks.objective: Check out the depths of the ruins

dialogues.text: You cannot spy on the secrets of the Abyss.
You have come here, you have seen our secrets. For this, you must pay the price.

dialogues.speaker: Abyss Herald
dialogues.text: As a Herald, I will mete out your punishment.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: An Abyss Herald!?

response.speaker: Abyss Herald
response.text: Dain... Dainsleif? Oh, I thought you were just a couple of pests that stumbled in here by mistake... So, you are with Dainsleif, that constant annoyance in our affairs...

response.speaker: Abyss Herald
response.text: Did he send you here to die? His resistance against the Abyss has gone nowhere for a long time. There is nothing you can do to change the tide...

response.speaker: Abyss Herald
response.text: The Abyss... is unstoppable!

choices.text: The monster we were tracking with Dain...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is this power...? Paimon's never seen it before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Careful! Please don't get cocky...!
